failure_modes: overly chaotic layout if hierarchy is not specified
asymmetry can reduce readability if section roles are vague

non_negotiables: do not use a generic layout
do not use evenly distributed grids unless a technical sub-section requires it
do not make the layout symmetrical only for symmetry
composition must feel art-directed, intentional, and slightly asymmetric
every section must feel carefully placed, not automatically generated

quality_gate: section sizes follow production importance
layout has hierarchy
negative space is intentional

failure_modes: too many empty fields weaken the prompt
machine-looking keys can replace visual specificity if values are vague
quality_gate: all required fields have concrete visual values
no vague praise-only values
aspect ratio and layout appear before subject detail

failure_modes: can over-smooth useful texture if applied too strongly
transparent-background instruction should not be used unless alpha output is required

surface_integrity_guard.prompt_suffix_for_image2_or_image_gen: The image is clean and transparent, with complete and natural materials, smooth and uniform texture, and the main subject Be clear, with distinct background layers, and avoid excessive sharpening, color spots, and noise Cracks, collapse, and distortion

quality_gate: texture remains natural
no scale-like pattern appears on skin, fabric, metal, or background
subject silhouette remains intact

strengths: reduces face, costume, and silhouette drift between panels
makes technical views and cinematic views describe the same subject
failure_modes: can make expression studies too stiff if performance direction is missing
can force unnecessary sameness when the board is meant to compare variants

consistency_locks.identity: same face, proportions, silhouette, and expression logic across all views
consistency_locks.costume: same garment structure, seams, accessories, and wear marks across all angles
consistency_locks.geometry: no reinterpretation between technical panels and cinematic panels

quality_gate: same subject reads clearly across every panel
turnaround and portrait share the same costume and silhouette
variant comparison is explicitly labeled if differences are intentional

strengths: uses category search instead of loading entire library
remixes patterns instead of copying prompts
failure_modes: viral prompt patterns may not fit production needs
unreviewed prompt imports can create inconsistent style
quality_gate: source recorded
pattern extracted rather than copied wholesale
fixture QA passed before active use

strengths: separates complete prompt, reusable core prompt, and targeted negative prompt
keeps subject, pose, environment, light, composition, camera, color, material, proportion, and intent distinct
reduces filler quality words by requiring concrete visual fields
failure_modes: full multilingual output is wasteful for normal DIRcreative production handoffs
reverse-prompt fidelity can conflict with director-led story intent if copied directly
race or ethnicity inference must be avoided unless required, visible, and appropriate to the project

evidence_policy.source_of_truth: use locked story, shot list, visual bible, references, and visible generated output; do not invent unseen details
evidence_policy.uncertainty_rule: when a visual fact is uncertain, write a broader production-safe description instead of an exact claim
forbidden: invented camera bodies or lens models
hidden objects not visible or locked upstream

director_mapping.composition_framing: foreground, midground, background, readable zone, negative space
director_mapping.style_camera: shot size, angle, lens feel, support, movement, focus
director_mapping.generation_intent: asset role and downstream video-model use

prompt_layers.director_recreation_prompt: complete production prompt for the exact asset
prompt_layers.prompt_core: short reusable lock preserving subject, composition, light, style, palette, and material
prompt_layers.negative_prompt: targeted artifact and drift avoid-list, never a generic quality dump

type_treatment.portrait: identity, skin/light interaction, expression, wardrobe, gaze, lens feel
type_treatment.product: silhouette, scale, material, function cues, support hardware, misread risks
type_treatment.poster_or_ad: title hierarchy, product/subject overlap, text zones, barcode/date/metadata blocks when visible or required
type_treatment.ui: layout grid, component hierarchy, typography, spacing, state, device/container
type_treatment.illustration: line, shape language, stylization level, palette, texture, medium
type_treatment.three_d: geometry, bevels, shader/material, lighting rig, camera angle, render finish
type_treatment.photography: shot size, lens feel, exposure, color temperature, depth of field, sensor or phone imperfection when intended

quality_language_policy.replacement_rule: replace broad praise with visible constraints such as edge behavior, texture continuity, readable labels, motivated lighting, lens compression, and material response

language_policy.default: single project working language plus exact displayed labels
language_policy.multilingual: use only when the deliverable, client handoff, or UI needs multiple language buckets

style_tags.purpose: compact routing metadata for registry search, QA clustering, and prompt UI
style_tags.rule: short, concrete, and not a substitute for the visual decomposition

quality_gate: visual decomposition fields are filled with concrete values
prompt layers exist for complex image assets
negative prompt targets artifact risks and continuity drift
no standalone filler quality terms remain
uncertain details are marked broadly instead of invented
